Author: Marco Lovato
Description: Switches StreamDeck profiles based on the active foreground window. Supports MSIX/WindowsApps (Teams, WhatsApp, Terminal) and window title matching — both impossible with the built-in Smart Profile feature.
Name: Auto Profile Switcher

Actions.Name: Auto Profile Switcher
Actions.Tooltip: Switches profiles based on the active window — supports MSIX apps and window title matching
